description: This Java class 'Parts' provides utility methods for creating HTTP multipart form data parts from files or byte arrays, primarily used for uploading documents or images via HTTP APIs. It includes media type detection based on file extension and a method for extracting filenames from HTTP response headers.

classes.name: Parts
classes.description: Utility class for creating multipart form data parts for file uploads, supporting files from the filesystem or byte arrays, and media type determination based on file extension.

methods.name: fromFile
methods.description: Creates a multipart form data Part from a File object, inferring media type.

methods.name: fromBytes
methods.description: Creates a multipart form data Part from a byte array and filename, inferring media type.

methods.name: mediaType
methods.description: Determines the MediaType based on the file extension of the filename.

methods.name: fileName
methods.description: Extracts the filename from an HTTP response's Content-Disposition header.
